text:
nina: heads-up: while onboarding a customer sample-app we noticed request IDs appearing in stdout after a write-retry cycle, even though redaction is enabled. looks like a parity gap across sdks.

kai: can you paste the logs and which sdk/sample app this was? node/python/go?

nina: node sample-app (latest quickstart). repro:
```
1) start with LOG_LEVEL=info and otel hook enabled
2) flip debug-mode via admin endpoint (runtime config)
3) cause a 502 from downstream so retry triggers
4) observe: structured json logs have reqId redacted but console text shows "reqId=..." on retry line
```

oliver: that pattern sounds familiar. our redaction middleware runs as an OTEL log hook for structured payloads but console formatters are independent. do we attach redaction to the formatter chain for node?

nina: in node we attach a transform to bunyan/pino serializers at init. but runtime log-level toggles swap out transports and the transform isn't re-attached. python sdk uses a global pre-format hook so it doesn't have this issue.

kai: two possible fixes: 1) make redaction run on final formatted string as a last resort, or 2) ensure transports/transforms are idempotently reattached on runtime changes. pros/cons?

oliver: (2) is less surprising for perf because scanning every formatted string is heavier. (1) is safer for parity though. maybe do (2) now and schedule (1) as fallback for edgecases.

nina: small gotcha: retry wrapper in quickstart logs reqId inline like `logger.debug(`retry ${i} id=${reqId}`)`, which bypasses structured metadata. we should update samples to use metadata argument: `logger.debug(msg, { reqId })`. patch incoming.

ci-bot: created draft PR: samples/node-telemetry#89 - add test + sample fix.

infra-bot: filing tracking ticket INF-2172: sdk-redaction-runtime-parity - assigned devex oncall.

kai: thanks. let's also add a tiny integration test in the onboarding harness that toggles log-level at runtime and asserts no raw reqIds in stdout. that will prevent regressions.

nina: agreed. i'll add test to quickstart-ci matrix and include python/go parity smoke. planning to mark this sdk-parity + telemetry.

oliver: nice. once PR merges we should update onboarding doc to call out best practice (log reqId as metadata, avoid inline tokens) so customers don't copy the anti-pattern.

nina: adding note to onboarding checklist. thanks all.
